parsed.summary: Every spec-stated pin mapping, component identity and passive value matches the drawing (TPS2121 mux IN1=+12V/IN2=+5V/OUT=VBUS with ILIM=51.1k and SS=10nF; AP63203WU buck with FB tied to +3V3, L1=3.9uH, C13 bootstrap; TPS1H200 heater switch with VS=+12V, IN/DIAG_EN=GPIO1, CL/GND/EP=GND, FAULT=TP6 only; three MAX31855 with shared SCK/SO and CS0/CS1/CS2 on GPIO4/6/7; USB-C CC=5.1k and D+/D- on GPIO19/18; WS2812B D1). The remaining apparent oddities (D7 symbol type, leftover LM73100/MPM3606 libraries, unmonitored FAULT pin) are explicitly documented known limitations, and the extra J5 terminal / fan clamp diodes D3-D4 are harmless and unspecified; no behavior-changing deviation is supported by the schematic.
